mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM AS cr LEFT JOIN CHAT_LOG AS cl ON cl.room_code = cr.code

SELECT cr.code, cr.room_id, cr.type,
mp.code AS other_code, mp.id AS other_id, mp.path AS other_profile_image,
cl.message AS last_message, cl.created_at AS last_message_time FROM CHAT_ROOM AS cr
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.code, m.id, i.path, m.rating FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m LEFT JOIN IMAGES i ON m.code = i.target_code AND i.TYPE = 'profile' ) AS mp ON mp.code = CASE WHEN cr.requester_code = #{memberCode} THEN cr.responder_code ELSE cr.requester_code END
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT log.room_code, log.message, log.created_at FROM CHAT_LOG AS log ORDER BY log.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS cl ON cl.room_code = cr.code
WHERE cr.requester_code = #{memberCode} OR cr.responder_code = #{memberCode}

SELECT cr.room_id, cr.type,
mp.code AS other_code, mp.id AS other_id, mp.rating AS other_rating, mp.path AS other_profile_image,
p.code AS product_code, p.title AS product_title, p.price AS product_price, p.thumbnail AS product_thumbnail,
cl.code AS msg_code, cl.sender_code AS msg_sender_code, cl.message AS msg_message, cl.created_at AS msg_created_at FROM CHAT_ROOM cr
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.code, m.id, i.path, m.rating FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m LEFT JOIN IMAGES i ON m.code = i.target_code AND i.TYPE = 'profile' ) AS mp ON mp.code = CASE WHEN cr.requester_code = #{memberCode} THEN cr.responder_code ELSE cr.requester_code END
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.code, p.title, p.price, i.path AS thumbnail FROM MARKET_PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN IMAGES i ON p.code = i.target_code AND i.type = 'market' AND i.order_seq = 1 ) AS p ON cr.type = 'DEAL' AND p.code = cr.target_code
LEFT JOIN CHAT_LOG cl ON cl.room_code = cr.code WHERE cr.room_id = #{roomId} AND (cr.requester_code = #{memberCode} OR cr.responder_code = #{memberCode}) ORDER BY cl.created_at ASC
SELECT CASE WHEN requester_code = #{senderCode} THEN responder_code ELSE requester_code END AS receiver_code FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
